component.name: XunCode
component.summary: Open-source code editor for Android and Linux

description.p: XunCode is a native, cross-platform code editor built with Flutter and the Monaco Editor engine. It brings a desktop-like editing experience to mobile devices and Linux desktops with a plugin ecosystem, embedded terminal, and deep customization options.

ul.li: Monaco Editor with syntax highlighting for 25+ languages
Embedded terminal (proot + Alpine on Android, native shell on Linux)
Proxy support and Tor via Orbot on Android
Custom themes, fonts, and UI language packs

screenshot.caption: Main editor with sidebar and terminal
